title: Payments
description: Money received: QR payments, slips, cash and transfers, with the invoices each one paid.

empty.title: No payments here
empty.body: Payments appear when residents pay or when you record one.

reverse.title: Reverse this payment
reverse.body: {amount} from unit {unit} is taken back: the invoices it paid are open again and its receipts are voided.

slips.title: Slips to review
slips.description: Transfer slips the automatic check could not confirm. Approve the amount received or reject with a reason the resident sees.

empty.title: No slips to review
empty.body: Slips that need a person appear here.

slips.duplicateBody: Another slip with the same transfer reference has been accepted.

decide.approveBody: Unit {unit}, invoice {invoice}. The amount read is {detected}; record what was actually received.
decide.amountHint: The amount read from the slip is filled in
decide.rejectBody: The resident of unit {unit} is told why and can send another slip.

slips.qrDuplicateTitle: A QR payment of the same amount is already booked
slips.qrDuplicateBody: This invoice was already paid by QR for the same amount. Approve only if the resident really paid twice; otherwise reject it with a reason.

manual.title: Record a payment
manual.description: Cash or a bank transfer received outside the app.
manual.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB
manual.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
manual.confirmBody: {amount} for unit {unit}, invoice {number}. A receipt is issued to the resident.

credits.title: Credits & refunds
credits.description: Money residents paid beyond what was due, and the receipts issued.
credits.creditsHint: Used on the next invoice unless refunded.

refund.title: Refund the credit
refund.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB

resendReceipt.title: Send the receipt again?
resendReceipt.body: Receipt {number} is sent to {payer} on LINE again (quiet hours and consent apply).

held.title: Payments to check
held.description: Money the bank reported that was not booked because it looks like a transfer already booked. Check the bank account, then book it or dismiss it.

empty.title: No payments to check
empty.body: A payment the bank reports that repeats one already booked waits here.

held.noPermission: An Owner or Manager (record payments) decides these.
held.neverBooked: Nothing is allocated, credited or receipted until you confirm it.

qr_already_paid.title: This QR was already paid
qr_already_paid.body: The bank reported money for a QR that is already paid — a repeated notification, or the resident scanned and paid twice.

possible_duplicate_transfer.title: Possibly the same transfer as one already booked
possible_duplicate_transfer.body: Same amount as a slip or hand-recorded transfer of the same payer and unit within the configured window.

held.confirmBody: Book {amount} from {payer} for {unit} as a second payment: it pays the oldest open invoices first, the rest becomes the payer's credit, and a receipt is issued.
held.dismissBody: {amount} for {unit} is marked failed and is never booked.
held.dismissReasonHint: For example: the bank repeated the same notification; checked against the statement.
